jobs.description:
WHAT WOULD YOU DO?

In your role as a Data Engineer you provide insights and solutions for complex data problems in order to implement end-to-end data solutions. You are responsible for the implementation and maintenance of the Data Warehouse and ETL infrastructure, where you will transform data into useful data formats for analysis. As a Data Engineer you will come across many varied and challenging projects: ranging from the design and implementation of the data warehouse and the development of ETL to the implementation and maintenance of reports and dashboards.

WHO ARE YOU?

• You understand the needs of the customer and can easily handle complex data environments.
• You are focused on collaboration, innovation and continuous improvement.
• You have strong communication skills and always strive for the best solution.
• You have an inquisitive mind and eager to learn.
• You are fluent in Dutch or French and have a strong knowledge of English.

WHAT ABOUT YOUR TECHNICAL SKILLS?

• Knowledge and hands-on experience with ETL and Data pipelines to integrate multiple data sources
• Experience with Data Warehouse environments
• Insights in setting up ETL processes and Data Flows
• Development and testing of ETL jobs
• Solid programming skills and SQL querying experience
• Hands-on experience with ETL tools is a plus
• Knowledge of Data Vault, Kimball is a plus
• Knowledge of Oracle, Google BigQuery or Microsoft Azure is a plus

With around 1,000 ‘Brabantians’, we are responsible for the worldwide production, marketing, sales and distribution of our Designed for Living products.

Brabantia has factories in Latvia, China and Belgium. At the Pelt site, we produce not only waste bins, but also bread bins and storage canisters. Adjacent to the production site is our distribution centre, from which Brabantia products are distributed worldwide.

More than 350 employees work at the Pelt site.

Jobomschrijving

Brabantia in Pelt is looking for Warehouse Operators!

Are you looking for a varied job in an international company? Then we are looking for you!

As a Warehouse Operator, you will be responsible for the following tasks:
	
• Manually picking orders	
• Packing and labelling products	
• Processing shipping documents	
• Working with handheld scanners
You will also help keep the working environment clean and tidy. You always work safely and support your colleagues whenever needed.

As a Warehouse Operator at Brabantia, you will have a varied range of tasks.
	
• You are available to work in 2 shifts: from 5:30 AM to 2:00 PM and from 2:00 PM to 10:30 PM. On Fridays, the early shift is from 5:30 AM to 1:00 PM and the late shift from 1:00 PM to 8:30 PM	
• You will work with handheld scanners and computer programs	
• Experience with these tools or the motivation to learn how to use them is therefore essential	
• You have experience operating an electric pallet truck or are willing to follow an internal training	
• You have your own means of transportation, as Brabantia is not accessible by public transport	
• You speak English fluently

jobs.description:
Our client is a leading international industrial group specialized in air filtration and environmental technologies. Present worldwide, the company supports customers throughout the entire lifecycle of their installations, from design and installation to commissioning and maintenance. To support continued growth, our client is looking for a Project Manager responsible for coordinating industrial projects and ensuring smooth execution from order intake through final delivery.

Jobomschrijving

• Manage industrial installation projects from order confirmation to completion.
• Serve as the primary point of contact for customers throughout project execution.
• Review customer orders and ensure alignment with quotations and contractual agreements.
• Coordinate subcontractors, installers and internal stakeholders.
• Monitor project timelines, budgets and deliverables.
• Negotiate scope changes and manage contractual deviations.
• Ensure administrative follow-up and project documentation are maintained accurately.
• Support commissioning activities and guarantee customer satisfaction.

• Experience in Project Management within an industrial, technical or engineering environment.
• Comfortable managing multiple projects simultaneously.
• Strong organizational and administrative skills.
• Able to work effectively under pressure and meet deadlines.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Technical affinity within industrial equipment, manufacturing or installation projects.
• Dutch and French are required; English is an asset.
• Experience coordinating subcontractors is considered a plus.

Our client is a well-established and highly respected real estate agency with a strong presence in the market. Operating in a fast-paced and dynamic environment, the company is known for its commitment to excellence, client-centric approach, and entrepreneurial mindset. With an international outlook and a diverse portfolio of clients and projects, the agency offers a stimulating workplace where collaboration, professionalism, and innovation are valued. Joining this organization means becoming part of a successful team that thrives on challenge, growth, and delivering exceptional service.

Jobomschrijving

• Provide comprehensive administrative and organizational support to the management team.
• Manage calendars, coordinate meetings, and organize business travel arrangements.
• Prepare, review, and maintain correspondence, reports, presentations, and other business documents.
• Act as a key point of contact for clients, tenants, landlords, and external stakeholders, ensuring professional communication at all times.
• Support the coordination and follow-up of real estate transactions, property management activities, and client projects.
• Organize internal and external events, meetings, and client visits.
• Maintain and update databases, CRM systems, and property-related records, ensuring data accuracy and confidentiality.

• Strong organizational and multitasking skills, with the ability to prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment.
• Excellent communication skills in English and French; additional languages are a strong asset.
• A proactive, solution-oriented mindset and a high level of professionalism.
• Strong attention to detail and the ability to handle confidential information with discretion.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office and familiarity with CRM or property management systems.

You will work as part of a team on the further development and optimization of applications using a modern version of .NET & Angular, with a strong focus on performance, testing, and clean code. You ensure stable communication between various internal systems.
Beyond your operational involvement, you will also have input into the broader technical direction. Within the team, you will have the opportunity to initiate technical improvements and actively contribute to building a robust and future-proof IT environment.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT (or equivalent through strong experience)
• Senior professional experience with .NET
• At least a first hands-on experience with Angular
• You're a pragmatic team player
• You work in English and understand Dutch & French

Are you driven by people, motivated by success and energized by building relationships? Do you enjoy spotting opportunities, making things happen and working in a team where ambition and collaboration go hand in hand? Then this could be your next career move.

As a Recruitment Consultant at Robert Walters, you'll combine your commercial drive with your passion for people. You'll connect organizations with experienced professionals, develop your own network and play a key role in helping businesses find the expertise they need.

We are looking to strengthen our Interim Management team in Brussels. If you're ambitious, entrepreneurial and ready to take ownership of your career, we'd love to meet you.

Your role

As a Recruitment Consultant, you'll be part of our Interim Management team, working at the intersection of people, business and opportunity.

You'll manage the recruitment process from start to finish, while building long-term relationships with organizations and professionals. No two days are the same: one moment you could develop a new business opportunity, the next you're speaking with an experienced professional about their next career move.

You'll have the opportunity to:

• Build and grow your own network of organizations and professionals within the Interim Management market
• Identify new business opportunities by understanding what organizations need and where you can add value
• Develop and maintain strong, long-term relationships with business partners
• Search for, assess and connect experienced professionals with the right interim management opportunities
• Manage the recruitment process from first contact through to successful placement
• Arrange interviews and ensure clear, proactive communication throughout the process
• Meet with prospective business partners and deepen existing relationships
• Proactively develop your portfolio through networking, market outreach and business development
• Work closely with your colleagues, sharing market knowledge, ideas and expertise
• Contribute to the success of the wider team while building your own track record
You'll have real ownership, clear targets and plenty of opportunities to make an impact.

What are we looking for?

We're looking for someone who is commercially minded, ambitious and genuinely interested in people.

You'll bring:

• A Bachelor's or Master's degree combined with at least 5 years of relevant professional experience within operations / finance 
• Excellent Dutch and very good English communication skills
• A strong commercial mindset and a genuine drive to achieve results
• An entrepreneurial attitude and the confidence to create and pursue new opportunities
• Strong negotiation skills and a strategic approach
• A natural interest in business, people and the world of work
• A strong team spirit and a collaborative mindset
You're someone who takes initiative, enjoys a challenge and isn't afraid to pick up the phone or open a new door. You know how to build trust, you're comfortable working towards targets and you're motivated by seeing the impact of your work. Above all, you're looking for more than just a job: you want to build a career where your ambition can grow with you.

As a warehouse worker in Wevelgem, you will be involved in the entire logistics process, from receiving to shipping goods. Every day, you use an electric pallet truck, forklift, and handheld scanner. You make sure everything is stored properly, orders are ready on time, and the warehouse stays tidy.
Your day starts between 7 and 8 AM, depending on your training. You pick orders, load and unload trucks and containers, and handle the administrative tasks related to shipments. For this, you use a PC, printer, and ERP system. You carry out simple visual checks and make sure everything runs safely and according to company guidelines. You actively participate in the daily team meeting with your colleagues and support each other.
Ready to roll up your sleeves and feel at home in a warehouse? Apply quickly and make a difference in a growing company!

You speak and write fluent Dutch (preferably), and/or English and/or French.You have a certificate for electric pallet truck and forklift.Experience in a warehouse environment is a plus.You work accurately and with a focus on quality.You are flexible and have a hands-on attitude.You enjoy working in a team and communicate respectfully.You actively participate in the daily team meeting.

Het bedrijf is een dynamische onderneming in Izegem, actief in de voedings- en verssector. Ze bieden een breed assortiment kwaliteitsproducten en zetten sterk in op klantgerichtheid en service. Hier werken betekent deel uitmaken van een hecht team dat vakmanschap en betrouwbaarheid hoog in het vaandel draagt.

Jobomschrijving

For our client, a family-run and growing company based in IZEGEM, we are looking for a production worker to strengthen the team. Do you enjoy working with fresh products, are you precise, and not afraid to work in a cooled environment? Then keep reading!

Your responsibilities:
	
• Cleaning, cutting, and packaging fruits and vegetables	
• Working according to hygiene and quality standards	
• Contributing to a smooth production flow	
• You’ll work in a cooled environment of around 7°C, with appropriate clothing provided
Working hours (full-time):
	
• Monday: off	
• Tuesday to Friday: 7:00 AM – 1:00 PM and 1:30 PM – 4:00 PM	
• Saturday: 6:00 AM – 12:25 PM

	
• You speak Dutch or English	
• You work accurately and hygienically	
• Previous experience in the food industry is a plus, but not required	
• You are physically fit and motivated

Our client is an international organization with a strong reputation in its sector and operations across multiple European markets. Known for its commitment to quality, responsible business practices, and continuous improvement, the company offers a collaborative and multicultural environment where people play a central role in driving success.

Jobomschrijving

As a Senior HR Business Partner, you will play a key role in supporting both employees and managers across several countries and functions.

Acting as a trusted HR partner, you will accompany teams throughout the employee lifecycle, provide day-to-day guidance on people-related topics, and help managers create engaging and high-performing work environments.

This role combines operational involvement with strategic HR initiatives. You will spend time close to the business, understanding the realities of different teams, supporting managers in their people challenges, and ensuring a consistent employee experience across the organization.

HR Partnership & Employee Support

• Act as the primary HR contact for employees and managers within your assigned business areas.
• Build strong relationships with teams and maintain a close understanding of business and people challenges.
• Support managers in addressing day-to-day HR topics, employee engagement, team dynamics, and people development.
• Accompany employees throughout their journey within the company, ensuring a positive and consistent experience.
• Regularly connect with teams across different locations to stay close to operational realities.

Employee Relations & People Management

• Advise and support managers on employee relations matters, performance concerns, wellbeing topics, and workplace issues.
• Ensure people decisions are aligned with company policies and local employment regulations.
• Facilitate constructive dialogue between managers and employees when needed.
• Support disciplinary processes and sensitive employee cases with professionalism and discretion.

Talent & Performance

• Coordinate performance management and talent review processes within your scope.
• Support managers in identifying development opportunities and building individual growth plans.
• Contribute to initiatives aimed at strengthening leadership and team capabilities.
• Participate in succession planning and talent development discussions.

Employee Experience & Engagement

• Support onboarding and integration activities to ensure a strong employee experience from day one.
• Contribute to engagement initiatives and help foster a collaborative and inclusive culture.
• Gather feedback from employees and managers and translate insights into practical improvements.
• Promote a culture of continuous feedback and development.

HR Projects & Continuous Improvement

• Contribute to HR projects, process improvements, and the implementation of new initiatives.
• Help improve HR tools, policies, and ways of working.
• Support HR reporting and analysis when required.
• Collaborate closely with other HR functions to ensure a seamless employee experience.

Experience & Background

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field.
• More than 7 years of experience as HR Business Partner within an international and fast-paced environment.
• Proven experience supporting both managers and employees across a broad range of HR topics.
• Strong exposure to employee relations, performance management, talent development, and organizational change.
• Good understanding of European employment legislation; experience across multiple countries is an asset.

Skills & Competencies

• Strong relationship-building skills and the ability to establish credibility at all levels of the organization.
• Hands-on and pragmatic approach, with a genuine interest in supporting people and solving problems.
• Excellent communication and coaching skills.
• Ability to manage sensitive situations with discretion and professionalism.
• Well-organized and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.
• Data-aware, with good knowledge of HR systems and reporting tools.
• Fluent in French and English; additional European languages are considered a plus.
• Collaborative, approachable, and committed to delivering an excellent employee experience.

As a sales assistant in this exclusive chocolate shop, everything revolves around experience, quality, and service. You welcome customers from all over the world with a smile, provide professional advice, and make sure every visitor leaves the store happy – with a delicious purchase.

On a typical day, you keep the store tidy, take care of product presentation, and actively assist customers. You process deliveries, monitor stock, and work closely with your colleagues to ensure smooth operations during peak times. You’re flexible, including during weekends and busy holiday periods.

Does a job where service, team spirit, and quality are key appeal to you? Then this is your chance to develop yourself in a unique retail environment. Apply today and discover if this role suits you!

• You have a well-groomed appearance and radiate energy

• You speak perfect English

• You have a basic knowledge of Dutch or are willing to learn quickly

• Extra languages such as Spanish, Russian, or Chinese are a big plus

• You work in a structured way and have an eye for detail

• You are organizationally strong and keep an overview

• You work well in a team

• You are flexible and willing to work weekends

• You are willing to work evenings during busy periods (store closes at 10pm, max. 11 late shifts/month)

• You are physically fit to process deliveries

• You have an educational background from primary, secondary, or higher education (all levels welcome)

• Experience in sales is a plus but not a must (all experience levels welcome)

As a Welder, you are responsible for welding aluminum profiles with quality and precision. You make sure every profile is processed according to the agreed guidelines, playing an important role in the production of design lighting fixtures.

A typical day includes operating the welding robot or TIG welding machine, preparing and cutting profiles, and setting the rolling machine. Together with your colleagues, you follow up on the order lists to ensure everything is completed accurately and on time. You work with great attention to detail and strive for a neat end result each time.

Are you passionate about technology and enjoy working with your hands? Do you want to be part of a team where you help create unique products? Apply quickly and discover this opportunity!

• Technical background
• Training in metalwork is a plus
• Experience as a welder (aluminum)
• You work accurately and pay attention to detail
• Good knowledge of Dutch or English

Are you the Incident Manager we’re looking for?

We are looking for an experienced Incident / Problem Manager to join an Application Support team based in Brussels.

You will play a key role in managing application-related incidents and problems, with a strong focus on reducing recurring incidents, improving service stability, and driving continuous improvement.

You will join a small, collaborative team and work closely with technical and application support teams to ensure incidents are effectively managed, root causes are identified, and appropriate corrective actions are implemented.
Role
• Manage the end-to-end Incident Management process for application-related incidents.
• Lead and coordinate the Problem Management process, including root cause analysis and corrective actions.
• Monitor and follow up on application-related incidents, ensuring appropriate prioritisation and resolution.
• Identify trends and recurring incidents and implement actions to reduce incident volumes.
• Support the management of incidents across different priority levels, including P3–P4.
• Monitor application environments using Datadog.
• Work with ServiceNow for incident and problem management.
• Analyse incident trends and identify opportunities for service improvement.
• Collaborate with application, infrastructure, and technical teams to resolve complex issues.
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of application support and IT service management processes.
• Participate in an on-call rotation, currently expected to be approximately one week in three. Out-of-hours incident volumes are currently low.
Profile
We are looking for someone with a backgound Incident Management, Problem Management, or Application Support experience.

You should have:

• Proven experience in Incident Management and/or Problem Management or Support engineering. .
• Previous experience within an Application Support environment.
• Experience working with ServiceNow.
• Experience with Datadog or a similar monitoring solution.
• Good working knowledge of SQL.
• A hands-on approach and the ability to work closely with technical teams.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Good communication and stakeholder-management skills.
• The ability to work effectively in a small, collaborative team.
• Fluent/professional English.

As an Operator (2-shift system) in the Bredene region, you recognize yourself in the following profile:

  • You have solid experience as an Operator;
  • You are motivated to work in the food industry within a production environment;
  • You are willing to work in 2 SHIFTS.
  • You speak Dutch or English.

As an OPERATOR NIGHTSHIFT in the Bredene region, you recognize yourself in the following profile:

  • You have a solid background as an operator;
  • You are motivated to work in the food industry within a production environment;
  • You are willing to work in a fixed night shift (21:00 – 05:00);
  • You speak Dutch or English.

Robert Half is currently looking for a PAN-EU Financial Controller (M/F/X) for a company located in the Beringen region.

Our client is an international organization with a well-established European hub in Belgium. The company operates in a fast-moving and structured environment, supporting large-scale operations across multiple countries while maintaining a strong focus on quality, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

The responsibilities for this job as PAN-EU Financial Controller (M/F/X) include:

• You take on a pan-European finance controlling role within an international finance team.
• You support financial reporting and controlling activities in close collaboration with local and international stakeholders.
• You report directly to the Finance Manager and contribute to the follow-up of key finance processes.
• You help ensure accurate analysis, reporting, and financial follow-up in an English-speaking business environment.
• You contribute to month-end closing activities and are prepared to provide extra support during the first working days of the month.
• You work closely with a small finance team in a multicultural and structured setting.

The requested qualifications for this job include:

• You hold a bachelor's degree in accounting, Finance, Taxation, or a related field, or you bring equivalent relevant experience.
• You have 1 to 5 years of experience in Accounting, Finance, Audit, or Controlling.
• You communicate fluently in English, both written and spoken.
• You combine strong analytical skills with the ability to work independently.
• You are comfortable using Microsoft Office in your daily work.
• You are a professional and respectful communicator with a strong work ethic.
• You have a mature, proactive, and hands-on mindset.
• You feel comfortable in a structured environment.
• You bring experience with SAP, IFRS, VAT, corporate tax, budgeting, forecasting, management reporting, or external audits as an advantage.
• You are motivated by working in an international and multicultural environment.

For a family-run metal workshop specializing in the production of steel doors and windows, we are looking for a semi-automatic welder to join the team. The company is known for its high-quality finishes, attention to detail, and passion for interior design and architecture. Every project is tailor-made — from design to the finished product — with a strong focus on craftsmanship and precision.

Job description:
As a semi-automatic welder, you will help produce steel doors and windows for both interior and exterior applications. You will be responsible for very fine welding work and ensure that every piece meets the highest quality standards.

Your tasks:

Performing fine welding work (semi-automatic)

Filing, grinding, and assembling components

• 
Cleaning and smoothing weld seams

• 
Reading and interpreting technical drawings

• 
Delivering precise, high-quality work

Profile:

• 
You have experience as a welder or are a motivated school leaver

• 
You can read and understand technical plans

• 
You have a good knowledge of Dutch or English

• 
You enjoy detailed, varied work during day shifts

Our client is a major real estate and infrastructure organization managing large-scale public-private partnership projects focused on the development, operation, and long-term maintenance of public facilities.

Jobomschrijving

• Manage a portfolio of approximately 25 building projects, coordinating maintenance activities and ensuring smooth collaboration between clients, contractors, and other stakeholders.
• Act as the main point of contact for administrative, technical, contractual, insurance, and damage-related matters, while mediating conflicts and facilitating mutually acceptable solutions.
• Coordinate maintenance requests, technical inspections, change requests, and interventions through a dedicated helpdesk and ensure proper follow-up with the relevant parties.
• Monitor the technical condition, regulatory compliance, and overall performance of the buildings, including annual condition assessments based on NEN 2767 standards and follow-up of corrective actions.
• Prepare and maintain accurate documentation, meeting reports, and records in the document management system, while supporting stakeholders in improving the energy efficiency of the buildings.

• Bachelor's degree in Construction Engineering, Facility Management, Real Estate, or equivalent professional experience, with 3-5 years of relevant experience in maintenance, technical consultancy, or real estate.
• Strong knowledge of building technical systems and maintenance requirements, ideally gained through experience with schools, offices, hospitals, or other large public/commercial buildings.
• Excellent communication, consultation, negotiation, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to mediate conflicts and build strong professional relationships.
• Proactive, customer-oriented, highly organized, and solution-driven, with strong attention to detail and the ability to work independently as well as within multidisciplinary teams.
• Fluent in Dutch, with a good command of French and English, and proficient in MS Office and technical/construction documentation tools such as CAD and relevant maintenance or project-management applications.

clients worldwide, with the goal of reducing greenhouse gas emissions, improving waterquality,
 

saving resources and making plants smart. By mastering and applying modelling techniques such
 

as bio/chemical kinetics, computational fluid dynamics (CFD) or the combination, you will unravel
 

what is happening inside water treatment systems and will be able to improve processes
 

significantly. After a while, you will be able to execute rather spectacular modelling work, for which
 

AM-Team is known. The complexity of the modelling projects will grow along with and will be
 

adjusted to your modelling knowledge and experience. You will also be developing a broad
 

knowledge on existing and novel industry processes.
 

The objectives of your modelling projects will be highly case dependent, but mostly you will make
 

clients happy by saving costs, saving energy, improving technology and competitive position,
 

accelerating technology development, and improving process performance and reliability.
 

Main responsibilities
 

• 
Project execution & delivery: Executing multiple modelling projects & delivery of the
 

project outcomes to the customers in the shape of reports and presentations. Typically,
 

projects execution involves. 2/3

manner.
 

o Organizing client meetings and preparing presentations & reports.
 

o Supporting other team members with expert knowledge.
 

•

projects and at international events or in online webinars. Writing technical abstracts,
 

journal articles and social media technical blogs or posts.
 

•

in close collaboration with the team. Creating templates and SOPs for existing modelling
 

methods.
 

• 
Coaching & training: Continuous learning & improving through active trainings. Also
 

coaching others.
 

You will be guided by senior colleagues at the start and will gradually grow and do your work more
 

autonomously.

related to working with modelling projects.

understanding and educational background of water treatment processes and/or
 

modelling of these processes. Knowledge and experience with CFD modelling is a plus.

o Why should the sky be the limit? You are a person that is not afraid to think out of
 

the box and set ambitious goals.

of our approach to our team and customers.
 

o We have no boundary conditions: we have no geographical, cultural, or technical
 

boundaries.

• Has ability to ask the right questions and carefully listen to clients to help them maximally
 

and truly understand their needs and problems.
 

• Has good (self) organisational skills and takes initiative.
 

• Has good presentation skills and can explain things simply, even when they are complex.

Dutch, French, or German).
